connector.name: 21st.dev
connector.registryDescription: Search 21st.dev UI components & themes, get their code, and generate new ones with 21st AI.
connector.summary: Hosted at 21st.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.21st, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your 21st.dev API key (get one at https://21st.dev/mcp). Discovery (initialize, tools/list) works without it; component code retrieval and generation require it.
